requirements.statement: apply_filters accepts one or many specs with field, optional model, optional op (default ==) and value; listed operators work on columns, hybrid properties and hybrid methods; nested and/or/not forms are validated and applied.

Models are found from entities, columns, aggregates, select_from and joins; a missing named model is auto-joined when the join can be inferred unless do_auto_join=False; ambiguous or absent models raise BadSpec and model-less queries raise BadQuery.
apply_sort applies asc/desc with nullsfirst/nullslast on columns and hybrids, with the same model resolution and automatic join.
apply_loads restricts loaded columns per named model, accepts the field-name list shorthand, auto-joins missing models, and restricted columns are not selected.
apply_pagination returns the limited/offset query and the (page_number, page_size, num_pages, total_results) tuple with documented defaults, raising InvalidPage for invalid input.
BadFilterFormat, BadSortFormat, BadLoadFormat, BadSpec, FieldNotFound, BadQuery and InvalidPage keep their meaning.
The same behavior holds when only SQLAlchemy moves from 1.4.54 to 2.0.38 with the rest of the lock unchanged; only Python modules under sqlalchemy_filters/ change.
